 CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi\-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
   

  

 We are seeking applications for the position of Sr. Lead Engineer \- Bridges for Delhi/Bangalore/Ahmedabad/Kolkata.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Take responsibility for Rail/Road bridge design, viaduct \& Structure design.
* Having experience designing steel structures/bridges with joint detailing.
* Prepare reports and calculations in line with Network Rail standards.
* Should take lead for team of 4\- 5 Junior Engineer’s / Draftsman.
* Plan and deliver bridge surveys and inspections, including recording of all relevant information
* Complete bridge assessment calculation and reporting.
* Manage delivery of projects – take responsibility for budget and resource deployment on projects.
* Where required take responsibility for project delivery to agreed budgets.
* Where required prepare estimates for work items.
* Identify scope change items.
* Manage resources at a project level to ensure utilization and productivity is maintained.
* Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to Company ISO Standards.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* BE\-Civil \+ M.Tech in Structural Engineering
* 5 to 10 years of experience into relevant field.
* Experience on Software requirement Sofistick, Midas, Oasys.
* Actively working towards Professional qualification.
* Ability to work in a collaborative multi\-discipline design team.
* Ability to complete assigned tasks with minimal supervision and provide support and mentoring to others.

title: Manager Operations
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Manager Operations** 
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**
* Asset Servicing team is part of the Markets and Securities Services Operations functions. AS team processes all voluntary and mandatory corporate action (including Income processing) across various UK, Europe and MENA jurisdiction.
* The department is also responsible for data validation for Equity and UK income collectives and capital mandatory corporate action. Team is divided into mainly three sub\-groups \- corporate action team (processes all capital voluntary \& mandatory corporate action), Income processing team (processes for Dividend, Coupon interest payment \& Pool factor processing) and corporate action validation team (validates corporate action for Equity, UK Income collectives, Capital mandatory corporate action).
* Ensure high\-quality service to the business area in terms of funds ensuring that risks are minimized and profit is maximized through effective management of costs. Ensure that process and procedures are continually reviewed and improved and the changes are communicated and implemented effectively. The job also entails checking on internal audits and measures undertaken and regularly reviews them in order to maintain quality and productivity at the optimum level.
* Responsible for managing performance and deliveries of funds/client sign offs to valuation teams. Contribution towards sustainable savings in relation to Process Efficiencies
* Supporting each global product on a regional basis by function or market. To plan for standardization of Asset Servicing processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim to enhance cost effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Role will be of individual contributor in nature and will not have team reporting to the role. Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures.
* High level variation and specific manual processes required by Product/System/Client/jurisdiction/ client
* To be aware of the Operational Risk scenario associated with the role and to ensure that all actions during your employment with HSBC take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Ensure effective escalation process is in place.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Bachelor’s degree in commerce or qualifications in accounting/finance industry or relevant experience. Detailed understanding of single sub\-process, control points, end to end process risk.
* Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Excellent knowledge of ICON/Geneva/Multifonds as accounting system.
* Excellent knowledge and relevant experience in Asset Servicing with clear understanding of the E2E Fund Accounting Model.
* Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.
* 3\-5 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Excellent Team Management skills with ability to handle personnel issues and strong team bonding.
* Efficient Time Management and ability to multitask work and priorities to meet defined deadlines. Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationships with other departments and jurisdiction thus ensuring smooth operations.
* Should have demonstrated behavior in line with HSBC values throughout. Strong working knowledge on MS Office
* Will be expected to maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, together with any issues raised by external regulators. Must be aware of the operational risk scenarios associated with this role and act upon pertinent risk (if any).


**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
 www.hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible work and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 7\-10 years of experience in designing and deploying IIQ\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ \& IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on\-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

* Minimum of 7\-8 years of experience in internal controls and Internal Audit

* IT Risk Assurance framework
* Control frameworks such as COSO, internal control principles and related regulations including SOX and J\-SOX
* Preferred security skills related to a broad range of operating systems, databases or security tools, e.g., UNIX, Linux, Windows 2000 and NT, firewalls and IDS systems
* Familiarity with IT analysis, delivery and operations methods, including ITGC, ITAC,SDLC, PAM and CM
* Familiarity with security and risk standards such as ISO 27001\-2, PCI DSS, NIST, ITIL, COBIT

title: Senior Project Control Specialist
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose** 
 : To lead the Project Controls team and manage all project planning, scheduling and cost management activities to ensure that projects are completed on time, on budget and required project services are delivered to Worley, and its client’s requirements.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior Project Control Specialist with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead the team, manage employee development and support career progression for the function.
* Ensure the services the team deliver meet project requirements to specified quality, on time and are within budget.
* Drive a culture of accountability within the group and enforce necessary measures when performance is inadequate.
* Drive a culture of ‘doing it right first time’ and delivering high quality deliverables that are part of fit for purpose solutions.
* Drive adoption of GID’s new way of operating.
* Build capability in the function to match capability needs identified by Works Management.
* Support implementation of a high performance delivery and unified GID organisational culture which spans across geographic locations and cultures.
* When necessary, perform project controls services.
* Ensure Continuous Improvement through the implementation of an Annual Improvement Plan and addressing lessons learnt.
* Develop, implement, improve and maintain Worley project controls systems, processes, practices and procedures.
* Review proposals for suitability of project scope, cost and scheduling requirements and coordinates development of all data in support of negotiations in line with Worley guidelines.
* Review Control budgets prepared for the projects and monitor deviation of the project cost with respect to the budgets prepared.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Interface with Project Management and Finance and Governance to prepare monthly internal reports, project control statements and MPRD reports.
* Partner with Workforce Planning to forecast personnel needs for projects.
* Liaise with other departments at meetings relative to project operations, to ensure that information affecting the project plan is continually updated.
* Proactively resolve any discrepancies between Worley and client’s requirements.
* Keep up to date with developments and innovations in the function.
* Demonstrate commitment to Zero Harm through regular actions and courageously speak up if work is being performed unsafely.
* Take accountability for own development and support the learning of others in areas of own experience by providing support to them as they are learning.
* Take initiative to get things done and do things before being asked by others.
* Apply standard procedures and processes to consistently deliver individual and team goals.
* Actively demonstrate WorleyParsons values and beliefs.
* Undertake any other reasonable duties as requested from time to time by the leadership team.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* 15\+ years of technical, practical and leadership experience in Project Controls in the same or similar industry, managing and leading large multi\-disciplinary projects and teams including 10\+ years of experience as project controls engineer / project planning engineer in engineering delivery organisation.
* Recognised degree in the relevant area or equivalent qualification/experience.
* Commercial experience, including contracts and procurement.
* Competent in the use of Primavera software package, Microsoft Excel, Access and other project controls specific software like PRA, Fuse etc.
* Able to make difficult decisions and lead others in changing business conditions.
* Can manage and resolve conflict between individuals and/or groups.
* Strong in negotiation of successful outcomes that achieve the required objectives and have the support and acceptance of all parties.


**Generic Competencies**
* Able to influence others, think ‘on your feet’ and have ability to work as part of a high performing team.
* Able to work effectively in small multi\-disciplinary teams, and share and transfer knowledge within teams.
* Able to share information to diverse audiences.
* Can listen and ask questions to ensure understanding.
* Able to use effective cross\-cultural communication skills.
* Able to develop and propose new approaches, methods, or technologies in response to changing business conditions.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Foundry Production Manager
description:
We're starting a new manufacturing plant in Kolkata. Using the lost\-wax/investment casting process, this venture will create multiple B2B and B2C brands, acting as a hub for metal/alloy casting from East India. We have already tested the market by outsourcing to third\-party vendors (Jaipur, Moradabad, Rajkot), even created one of the intended brands with a solid customer base. Now, we're about to in\-house the entire production within greater Kolkata area, from start to finish.
 



  





 For running this plant, we need a professional with several years of foundry experience.
 



  




* Experience with non\-ferrous alloys like Zamak and brass.
* Preferred to have experience with lost\-wax or investment casting process, but similar processes like die\-casting or sand casting can be considered as well.
* Ideally, you should have some idea about the entire production process from molds, wax patterns, and ceramic slurry mixtures to casting and finishing/polishing.
* We're open to having you join us as a partner or on a profit\-sharing basis, instead of a salary.



  





 Further, we'd prefer it if you have one or more of the following qualities:
 



  




* Fixing production issues and finding smart solutions for casting\-related defects
* Contacts/leads of workers and artisans we can approach to work under me
* Supervising a plant during the day and ensuring quality production
* Experience in export\-quality production where items were sold out of India
* Specialization in smaller parts and decorative items
* Technical background to adjust issues with sprues/gates and material composition
* Mechanical background to fix issues with casting\-related machinery
* Good grasp on the post\-production process (finishing, filing, polishing, buffing, etc.)

**Job Description**

 Job Summary
   

  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Project Manager – Planning**

The role will be responsible for developing project schedules, tracking progress, forecasting risks, and ensuring timely project delivery through effective planning and coordination with cross\-functional stakeholders.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Project Planning \& Scheduling
   

  




* Develop detailed project schedules, work breakdown structures (WBS), and execution plans.
* Establish project milestones, critical paths, and resource\-loaded schedules.
* Prepare baseline schedules and monitor project performance against approved plans.
* Ensure alignment of project timelines with business objectives and client requirements.



 Project Monitoring \& Control
   

  




* Track project progress and identify schedule variances.
* Analyze delays, bottlenecks, and potential risks impacting project delivery.
* Generate daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports for management and clients.
* Monitor project productivity and recommend corrective actions to maintain timelines.



 Resource Planning
   

  




* Coordinate with project teams to optimize manpower, equipment, and material allocation.
* Develop resource histograms and workforce deployment plans.
* Ensure efficient utilization of project resources across multiple projects.



 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  




* Collaborate with project managers, design teams, procurement, and site execution teams.
* Facilitate planning review meetings and project status discussions.
* Provide planning insights and recommendations to senior leadership and clients.



 Risk Management
   

  




* Identify project risks, schedule constraints, and mitigation strategies.
* Conduct delay analysis and impact assessments.
* Develop recovery plans and acceleration programs whenever required.



 Cost \& Performance Reporting
   

  




* Support project control functions including cost tracking and forecasting.
* Monitor earned value metrics and project performance indicators.
* Prepare dashboards, MIS reports, and management presentations.
* Assist in budget planning and project forecasting activities.



 Documentation \& Compliance
   

  




* Maintain project planning documentation, schedules, and progress records.
* Ensure adherence to organizational project management standards and procedures.
* Support contract management by providing schedule\-related inputs for claims and extensions of time (EOT).



  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, Primavera P6, or equivalent project planning certification preferred.
* 10–12 years of experience in project planning and controls within construction, infrastructure, real estate, or interior fit\-out projects.
* Experience managing planning functions for large and complex projects.



 Required Skills \& Competencies
   

  




* Expert knowledge of
 **Primavera P6** 
 , MS Project, and project scheduling techniques.
* Strong understanding of Critical Path Method (CPM) and project control methodologies.
* Proficiency in project reporting, forecasting, and schedule analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong leadership and coordination abilities.
* Advanced knowledge of project lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI, and project management tools.

title: Site Supervisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Garuda Design Studio is a collaborative practice of designers, architects, engineers, and project managers dedicated to creating thoughtful, functional living spaces. The studio focuses on vernacular contemporary design, blending local character with modern comfort and usability. Projects emphasize purity in design, natural materials, and a strong connection to the surrounding environment. Team members work closely together to deliver spaces that feel cozy, livable, and intentionally crafted. The culture supports creativity, technical excellence, and a commitment to sustainable, people\-centered design.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Site Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day activities at project sites. This position coordinates with designers, architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors to ensure that work is executed according to drawings, specifications, and safety standards. Daily responsibilities include monitoring site progress, managing manpower and resources, maintaining quality control, and documenting work through reports, photographs, and checklists. The Site Supervisor also handles basic issue resolution on site, escalates technical concerns to the design and engineering teams, and supports adherence to timelines and budgets. The role involves regular site inspections, communication with clients or client representatives, and ensuring compliance with local regulations and company procedures.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to supervise construction sites, including monitoring daily activities, coordinating trades, and ensuring adherence to design and technical specifications.
* Strong skills in site planning and organization, including scheduling, resource allocation, and basic project coordination with internal teams and external vendors.
* Working knowledge of construction methods, materials, and finishes relevant to residential and vernacular contemporary designs, with attention to quality and safety.
* Competence in documenting site work through reports, measurements, photographs, and checklists, and maintaining accurate records for project tracking.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills for collaborating with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients, and for resolving routine on\-site issues.
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings, and translate plans into clear instructions for site teams.
* Understanding of basic health, safety, and environmental standards applicable to construction sites in the Kolkata metropolitan area.
* Relevant experience as a Site Supervisor or similar role in architecture, interior design, or construction projects; residential or small\-scale projects experience is advantageous.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience may be considered.
* Willingness to work primarily on site, travel between project locations within the metropolitan area, and adapt to changing project demands.
